messages:
liam: Quick ops note for the release train this week. We're running a short maintenance window Friday 01:30-05:30 UTC to push a security kernel patch to the inference hosts. Expect canary routing to tilt to us-west for ~90 minutes mid-window. Post exceptions here by 18:00 PT today.

ana: typo? do you mean ana :)

liam: oops yes @ana. Thanks.

ana: ack. Which stacks are impacted?

liam: Affected: inference-core, cache-service, router. Excluded: platform-ui, analytics-ingest. We'll avoid touching customer-dedicated pools unless absolutely necessary.

priya: we have an ongoing model rollout for ranking that is scheduled to finish Fri morning. Can we get an exception so it can continue? Owner: priya.

liam: Please file an exception request here with owner + risk statement. Quick judgement: low-risk smoke-tested rollouts get allowed if they don't touch kernel-level libs. If it's touching quant kernels, we'll defer.

priya: filing: ranking-rollout (owner: priya) - smoke passed on canary, doesn't use quant kernels, needs final ramp to prod for feature release.

deploy-bot: Exception received: ranking-rollout. Auto-rollouts temporarily permitted under embargo exception ID RTX-318. :white_check_mark:

tom: ops question: what will the routing tilt command look like? want to pin to oncall runbook.

ops-bot: Routing tilt will be executed as: `routingctl shift --from global-canary --to us-west-tilt --percent 70 --duration 90m`

liam: also note we'll provision 2 extra small GPU nodes in us-west to handle the shifted canary traffic. ops will tear them down automatically after the window.

ana: I'll update the Console banner and add a short blurb in the release dashboard: "Planned maintenance Fri 01:30-05:30 UTC. Canary tilt to us-west ~03:00 UTC. Check this thread for exceptions."

priya: if ranking rollout is allowed, I'll hold on validating post-tilt until the extra nodes are up. Who will signal go/no-go?

oncall: Oncall will monitor key signals (error-rate, p95 latency, cache-miss spikes). We'll post a green/red 5-minly update during the tilt window.

liam: fallback plan (added for clarity):
```
fallback_policy: revert-to-stable
trigger: sustained error-rate > 1.5% OR p95 increase > 60% for 3 consecutive 5-min windows
action: stop new canary traffic, route -> model:stable, scale-down tilted pool, notify -> #incidents, run rolling restart on router pods
```

priya: noted. We'll have a quick smoke run queued that triggers after the nodes ready event.

tom: pinning the infra command too: `infractl node provision --zone us-west-2 --type gtx-small --count 2 --ttl 3h`

deploy-bot: Scheduled jobs created: ui-banner (2147595600), provision-us-west-tilt (2147596800), routing-tilt (2147597000)

liam: final reminder: exceptions close at 18:00 PT. If you need an emergency exception after that, escalate to @oncall and include rollback playbook.

ana: I'll send a short email summary to product and partnerships with the customer-facing impact note.

priya: thanks everyone. Will post the smoke results here once run completes.

oncall: we'll be watching. Will post updates in-thread during the window. :eyes:
